sn35.148:1.4: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu Cakkhuṃ dukkhanti passati || Rūpā dukkhāti passati || Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ dukkhanti passati || Cakkhusamphasso dukkhoti passati || Yam pidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tam pi dukkhanti passati || || 4-7 Sotaṃ || || Ghānam || ||
sn35.148:1.6: Mano dukkhoti || Dhammā dukkhā ti || Manoviññānaṃ || Manosamphasso || Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tam pi Dukkhanti passati || || 9
sn35.148:1.7: Ayaṃ kho sā bhikkhave sappāyā paṭipadāti || || 2
